- Lots of bug fixes
  - SDR: the radio no longer falls silent ("No more samples from the radio") when switching from one tool to another
  - SDR: a tool stopped while its radio was still starting no longer starts receiving afterwards, and two tools can no longer end up on the radio at the same time
  - SDR: transmitting (APRS beacon, push to talk) first stops the tools still receiving in the background
  - Spectrum: the measured width of a signal (DMR, 4FSK…) no longer changes with the position of the marker, and no longer swallows a neighbouring signal
  - Spectrum: long averaging now really overlaps its FFTs
  - All 22 languages: every text is translated again, nothing is left in English
- SDR: better sensitivity, frames are now decoded further away and closer to the noise, thanks to the phone's processor
  - Damaged frames are repaired from their least certain bits before being dropped (AIS, APRS, CubeSat 1200 and 9600 baud, ANT+, FLARM, DECT, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Wireless M-Bus, Sigfox), never at the cost of a wrong frame
  - LoRa (Meshtastic, MeshCore, LoRa APRS, LoRaWAN): weak frames synchronise much better, and a bad CRC is repaired with the second most likely symbols
  - ADS-B: frames whose bits fall between two samples are read again
  - Spectrum: a new long averaging that brings steady carriers out of the noise
- SDR: a free frequency in the tools (DSC, AIS, ACARS, FLARM, Z-Wave, M-Bus, VDL2, PMR446, LoRa APRS, MeshCore, ISM, TPMS), handy for other regions
- Spectrum: opening a tool from the signal analysis now gives it the signal's frequency
- Listen: a new DMR/dPMR mode that plays digital voice on any frequency and shows who talks to whom; encrypted calls stay silent
- Spectrum: the spectrum stays at the top of the screen, the analysis opens from a magnifier button that lights up when a signal is recognised, the marker can be placed on the waterfall, and dragging it to an edge scrolls the spectrum
- The floating dock hides inside the tools and comes back when they are closed, and the featured SDR tool hides when a category is open
